title: networking-fun lab manifest
description: Schema for .platform/manifest.yaml. Validates the lab/scenario/ttl/notes declared by a PR. v1 accepts only the layered-reachability lab and the happy-path scenario; slices 8 and 11 expand the enums.

lab.description: Lab to provision. v1: layered-reachability only.

scenario.description: Fault scenario for the chosen lab. v1: happy-path only.

ttl.description: Time-to-live duration (e.g. 30m, 2h). Capped at 4h by the validator; default 4h.

notes.description: Free-text note rendered in the PR comment.
